character.name: Frozen In Flames
character.name_note: Given names Frozen In, family name Flames. In daily life the character is usually called Frozen.
character.occupation_frame: Musician and recording engineer; founder of a small recording studio.
character.status: Living. No death year is recorded: the character's story is open, by design, so the same character can take later surveys in other genres.

defining_events.event: Born in Memphis, Tennessee, the first child of Evelyn and Harold Flames.
Began paid work after school in his father's repair shop, rewiring radios and restringing guitars.
First recording session work, as an unpaid assistant in a Memphis studio, paid in tape and lessons.
Founded his own small recording studio, the Cold Room, in a converted icehouse.
Married Alice Verano, a photographer he met when she was hired to shoot a session.
A fire destroyed the first Cold Room; he rebuilt it over two years rather than close.

fact_notes.father_name: Harold Flames; repaired radios and guitars in a small Memphis shop.
fact_notes.mother_name: Evelyn Flames, born Evelyn Hart; piano teacher and church organist.
fact_notes.partner_name: Alice Flames, born Alice Verano; a photographer.

open_by_design: No death year and no closing chapter facts: later genre packs need room to keep asking this character questions.
Geography after Memphis is deliberately loose (years of session work and travel) so later packs are not contradicted.
The catalogue of the character's recordings is described by kind, not enumerated, so later packs can specify it.
provenance: Fabricated demonstration material. Frozen In Flames is a fictional persona created for this project; the life recorded here was invented as test data and describes no real person.
purpose: Canonical demonstration character record for the survey-to-book proof-of-works series. Frozen In Flames is the series' demonstration user: the demo answers for every genre pack are this character's answers, drawn from this single invented life, so the same character headlines every proof book.
